name: Nosoi's Spiritsense
body:
Source Pathfinder #139: The Dead Road pg. 71
Even the lowliest psychopomp can sniff out the undead. A whippoorwill in a papier-mâché mask taught you how to do it.

Prerequisites: Duskwalker.

Benefit: You can cast detect undead as a spell-like ability at will. Your caster level for the purpose of this effect is equal to your character level.
